5978d61c28.why: The shuffled load, both carryless products, both XOR results, and pointer update are required, and AVX2 cannot fuse the XORs or load the data operand of VPSHUFB.

8e709963cb.why: The dependent reduction operations, loaded multiplier, extraction, and VZEROUPPER all contribute to required final register values.

ca588f3293.why: Moving EDI into a zeroed vector and shifting its low word into the highest word require separate instructions, while the broadcast and carry-producing comparison are also live.

98c785f8a9.why: VPSHUFB cannot take its data source from memory, so the load, shuffle, XOR, and required pointer update cannot be shortened.

c225bc1565.why: The data load cannot fold into VPSHUFB, and the shuffle, XOR, pointer update, and separate live multiplier load are all required.

0f3b9d03ba.why: The arbitrary shuffle control requires a separate data load and shuffle before the XOR, and the comparison must produce the required CF and ZF.

9b23cb1b98.why: All three shuffled vectors and both scalar updates are live, and the final comparison produces CF and ZF that the length update alone does not reproduce.

8ec28ea8ae.why: Each independent fold needs two carryless products and its existing three-input XOR, while the broadcast result and final ZF are also required.

0adc7c39ab.why: Both folds already use ternary XOR, their data loads cannot fold into VPSHUFB, and the final high-product value and pointer update are live.

c15f9ccd09.why: The live broadcast, two independent carryless products, ternary XOR, and required ZF test each need their existing instruction.

bc19ba1eb3.why: The unmerged data load and shuffle, two carryless products, ternary XOR, and pointer update are all necessary for the required outputs.

4fee0f9982.why: The upper-half extraction supplies an independent ternary-XOR input, and the live broadcast, two products, and ZF test cannot be removed.

ca9177943a.why: The shuffled data requires a separate load, and the two products, existing ternary XOR, and pointer update already form a tight fold.

67c19d7911.why: The multiplier and high product are live, the extracted upper half is needed by the ternary XOR, and the final test must preserve ZF.

8120980d7f.why: The shuffled vector and high product are required outputs, and the low product, ternary XOR, and pointer update leave no removable instruction.

b20c4579e5.why: The XORs are separated by dependent carryless products, and the live vector results, extraction, multiplier load, and upper-register clearing prevent a shorter sequence.

b185cc77f0.why: Folding MOVDQU into legacy PXOR would impose an unguaranteed 16-byte alignment requirement, while the vector initialization and final comparison remain necessary.

97cfdf2705.why: All three loads and both scalar updates are live, and the length update cannot also produce the required comparison flags.

d2d6c10c9a.why: Each SSE fold needs a copy, two products, and two XORs, and folding the unaligned data loads into legacy PXOR would require an unstated alignment guarantee.

eb41da60a8.why: Destructive SSE carryless multiplication requires a copy for each pair of products, and both XORs per fold, the live multiplier load, and the ZF test are necessary.
